notes.title: Steam Deck Update Bug Causes Boot Loop [SOLVED]
notes.content:
Hello everyone, if you updated your Steam Deck recently, you might be experiencing a boot loop. When you start the game, it seems like it never opens up and then you have to hard reboot your game. This is an issue with the recent Steam Deck update.

Thankfully, there is a quick solution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41280370/c13c85a6156a46c456daed51ebb0e4357dd5f153.jpg[/img]

Go to Settings -> properties -> compatibilities

Tick the box that says "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool"

For now, you can use Proton Experimental, Proton 7.0-5, or GEProton. Any of the recent protons should work.

If anybody has any Steam deck issues. please contact me in any way that works for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41280370/669df0dc6c04cd5ac74a83630f4dbd51b7693c13.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Japanese version postponement notice
notes.content:
We are very sorry that we originally planned to complete the Japanese version at the same time as "Grey Heritage: Faded Vision" was released.
However, due to various reasons, there were some problems in the production of the Japanese version, which could not be completed simultaneously when it was released.

The translation and production of the Japanese version are still in progress, and we expect to update the Japanese version by the end of January 2023.
We would like to apologize to everyone here.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest October 2022 (October 8th)
notes.content:
I'm so happy to be a participate for Steam Next Fest! To celebrate, I will be playing Grey Heritage: Faded Vision and will answer any questions you may have! The game will release on December 9th, 2022. Feel free to try out the demo before you make your decision on trying out Grey Heritage!

Grey Heritage: Faded Vision is the first in a series by BTrain Studio. Come help Prince Leon as he reclaim his rightful birthright from a long lost friend!
